name: boc_get_exchange_rate
description:
Bank of Canada daily exchange rates: Canadian dollars per 1 unit of a foreign currency, from the Bank of Canada Valet API (no API key).
Returns: series_name, label, description, dimension, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first.
Inputs: currency_pair (XXX/CAD, e.g. USD/CAD; reads Valet series FX<XXX>CAD) or indicator (usd_cad, eur_cad, gbp_cad, jpy_cad, cny_cad; wins over currency_pair); one is needed; start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD; either or both); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; the last N observations, used only when no date is given).
For the latest rate alone use boc_get_latest; for other central banks' rates ecb_get_exchange_rate or rbi_get_exchange_rate.
Example: {"currency_pair": "EUR/CAD", "recent_periods": 30}

currency_pair.description: Currency pair in format 'XXX/CAD' (e.g., 'USD/CAD', 'EUR/CAD'). Always quotes in terms of CAD.

recent_periods.description: Number of recent observations to retrieve (1-100)

series_name.description: Bank of Canada FX series identifier

description.description: Detailed information about the exchange rate

value.description: Exchange rate value (CAD per unit of foreign currency)
